summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of UMKM Pay multi-tenant SaaS. Backend: 28/28 pytest cases pass covering auth (super admin/UMKM register/login), products CRUD + tenant isolation, POS sales (cash, QRIS, kasbon with customer balance increment + partial payment), expenses, dashboard summary, reports summary + Excel/PDF export, cashiers (creation + role RBAC: cashier blocked from product create/reports/cashiers/admin endpoints), outlets create/delete, file upload + protected download, subscription submit/approve/reject (approval extends subscription_end), super admin stats/list UMKMs/toggle suspend (blocks login), platform settings update including QRIS image. Frontend: super admin login redirects to /admin panel, UMKM register lands on /app with 14-day trial toast, product create works, POS cash sale + QRIS sale both produce success dialog, dashboard and reports pages load.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing DialogTitle — a11y warnings in console; wrap title with VisuallyHidden or add explicit DialogTitle

action_items: Optional: add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden) to POS QRIS and Success dialogs to remove Radix a11y console warnings
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 806 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, products, txns, admin, reports) for maintainability
get_current_user still checks cookies but auth is JWT bearer only — cookie path is dead code (harmless)
reports/export and files download accept token via query string (?auth=) — acceptable for anchor downloads but tokens will land in server access logs; consider signed short-lived download URLs
delete_cashier uses ObjectId(cid) — will raise if cid is not a valid ObjectId (500); add try/except → 400/404

toggle_umkm suspends by flipping is_active on all UMKM users including the umkm_admin, which is the intended behavior; but existing JWTs remain valid until expiry (7 days) since only login re-checks is_active — consider adding is_active check in get_current_user
